symptom: After mx convert to Mendix 11.17.0, re-applying an idempotent `create or modify change data capture service` reported 'Modified' and mx check failed CE1585 ('There are changes in your … document'). The rewritten unit shrank back to its exact 11.16.1 size (2,982 bytes, against 3,261 after the conversion).
cause: Mendix 11.17 records five facts in the baseline: DecimalScale on the VersionedEntityChangeDataCaptureService, and AssociationMultiplicity, IsNullable and MaxLength on every VersionedProperty. The generated types had none of them, so the rebuild dropped them, and mxbuild's domain-vs-baseline comparison reported a change.
fix: Hand-added the fields to the gen types and derived them from the domain model, written only on 11.17.0+. The rules come from Studio Pro's createBaseline in change-data-capture-editor/editor.js: DecimalScale is Settings$RuntimeSettings.DecimalScale. IsNullable is false for a required rule, a Boolean or an AutoNumber. MaxLength is a String's length, else 0. Multiplicity is ManyToMany for a reference set, OneToOne for a reference owned by both sides, else OneToMany. An attribute gets "" for multiplicity, and an association true for IsNullable (the metamodel default). A change to a recorded fact is a major version bump, as the editor rates it; a baseline that recorded none is no change.
insight: Two traps. (1) The issue read DecimalScale as a per-member field; it sits once on the baseline element. Dump the converted unit and read the editor's createBaseline instead of inferring placement from counts. (2) ValidationRule.AttributeID holds the attribute's QUALIFIED name, not its $ID. A rule matched by $ID found nothing, IsNullable came out true for a required attribute, and only mx check (CE1585) caught it. The unit test had modelled the $ID. mx stores the integers as int64. Verified on 11.17.0: the issue's repro writes nothing on the second run, mx check reports 0 errors, an already-damaged service is repaired byte-identical to mx convert's output, and an 11.16.1 project's unit is byte-identical before and after.
test: mdl/backend/modelsdk/cdc_baseline_1117_2612_test.go (derivation rules, encoded facts at 11.17, none below, version bump); mdl/executor/cdc_1117_2612_integration_test.go (-tags integration, mx 11.17.0: mx check 0 errors and the re-run unchanged; with the writes stubbed out it fails CE1585); modelsdk/gen/changedatacapture/handadded_test.go
